title: QUIC child-stream multiplexing
summary: Dev3 adds real bidirectional QUIC child streams while preserving the ordinary one-stream SocketStreamAdapter compatibility path.
invariants: openStream, acceptStream and tryAcceptStream expose genuine OpenSSL QUIC stream objects rather than emulated framing.
Distinct child streams retain distinct QUIC stream IDs on one connection.
QuicStream may be wrapped in SocketStreamAdapter so a selected child stream still presents the common byte-stream contract.
Multiplexing is additive; applications that only require an ordinary stream are not forced into a QUIC-specific API.
